title: Colour key: the three germ layers

objective.text: Name the three germ layers in their order in the week-3 disc.

body.general: What are the three layers that build a body? They are the germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm [f1]. Ectoderm is the top layer, on the back side [f2]. Mesoderm is the middle layer [f3]. Endoderm is the bottom layer, facing the yolk sac [f4]. Together, these three build every tissue of the body [f5].
body.mbbs: By the end of week 3 the embryo has three germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm [f1]. Ectoderm lies dorsally, on top [f2]. Mesoderm lies between ectoderm and endoderm [f3]. Endoderm lies ventrally, facing the yolk sac [f4]. Every tissue of the embryo comes from one of these three [f5].

facts.text: By the end of week 3 the embryo has three germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm.
Mesoderm is the middle layer, between ectoderm and endoderm.
Endoderm is the bottom (ventral) layer, facing the yolk sac.
Together the three germ layers build every tissue of the embryo.

misconceptions.wrong: Endoderm is the middle layer ('endo' sounds like 'inside').
misconceptions.right: Mesoderm is the middle layer; endoderm is the bottom layer, facing the yolk sac.

misconceptions.wrong: Mesoderm comes from the hypoblast, so the layers have different starting points.
misconceptions.right: All three germ layers come from the epiblast.

checks.prompt: Put the germ layers in order from the back (dorsal) side down.
checks.why: Ectoderm is on top, mesoderm in the middle, endoderm at the bottom facing the yolk sac.

checks.prompt: Which germ layer sits in the middle?
checks.why: 'Meso' means middle: mesoderm lies between ectoderm and endoderm.

adult: Every tissue of the adult body traces back to one of these three layers [f5].

remember.q: What are the three germ layers, top to bottom?
Which germ layer faces the yolk sac?
